gold.user: User wants to retrieve a list of all plans available in their Jira Cloud instance.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of plans, including their IDs, names, and statuses.

gold.user: User is creating a new plan for their project, specifying the necessary details such as name and associated issues.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating the plan has been created, along with the new plan ID.

gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the plan has been updated with the new details.

gold.user: User wants to archive a plan that is no longer in active use to keep their workspace organized.
